about: Every ActiveOn component and view to design in the Design Lab, in three design groups. Each component lists its purpose, where its data lives in data/*.json (paths are into that file; "*" means every element), 2-4 variation ideas that change the UX (not just the look), and the brief.md principles it serves. All names in data are scrubbed (Char1…, class + level).

principles.P2: One next step, and it is the product
principles.P3: Who, where, how long, every line
principles.P7: One job, many characters: group it
principles.P8: Stable places; state by colour plus glyph plus word
principles.P11: The save is the checklist, and it is honest about age
principles.P12: Earned delight in our own pixel art

dataFiles.data/scrubbed-w2.json: World 2 late, 5 characters, fresh; 4 of 5 Ready, 1 Fix + 1 account blocker; 13-step Walkthrough; 14 Spend lines
dataFiles.data/scrubbed-w3.json: World 3 early, 6 characters, fresh; 4 of 6 Ready, 2 Fix (preset swaps); Walkthrough, printer plan, 15 Spend lines
dataFiles.data/scrubbed-w3-stale.json: Same as w3 with the save's own timestamps (about 8.5 h old): caps full on nearly every row
dataFiles.data/latest.json: Toolbox public late-game save, 11 characters, World 4 entry; 0 Ready, 10 Fix, 1 Unknown; no Spend Plan or Walkthrough
